gaps.explanation: Statement pp6-7 Total Governmental Funds Total revenues 15,725,221 (GAAP; columns General 6,946,839 + Streets 3,321,162 + Economic Development 1,631,059 + Debt Service 1,018,434 + Special Projects 1,324,144 + Leasing Corporation (328) + Other Governmental Funds 1,483,909 = 15,725,219, printed total 2 higher, report rounding). detail[] 19,974,211 = budget-basis schedules pp14-19 Total revenues: General 10,561,998 + Streets 3,442,236 + Economic Development 1,725,368 + Debt Service 1,243,848 + Special Projects 1,516,789 + Leasing Corporation 63 = 18,490,302, plus nonmajor combining pp20-21 1,483,909 (= Other Governmental Funds column). Every governmental fund column is in detail[]; the six major funds are printed only on the budget basis (Taxes / Intergovernmental / Local), which differs from GAAP per fund: General +3,615,159, Streets +121,074, Economic Development +94,309, Debt Service +225,414, Special Projects +192,645, Leasing +391 = 4,248,992 (= gap 4,248,990 + the 2 report rounding). Budget basis vs GAAP: General -20,949 (p14 9,554,766 vs p6 9,575,715), Streets +247,848 (p15 4,788,144 vs p6 4,540,296), Economic Development -785 (p16 2,191,992 vs p6 2,192,777); net +226,114 = the gap. No missing or duplicate lines. No fix.

pp6-7 governmental funds statement, Other financing sources: 'Proceeds from sale of assets' General Fund column 24,358 (p6) and 'Insurance proceeds' Special Projects Fund column 417,952 (p7; the Total column prints 417,950, a 2 rounding difference in the report). detail[] has only the two transfer lines (General Transfers In 3,172,380, Streets Transfers Out (250,759)); the budget-basis schedules pp14-19 print no other-financing section, and the Special Projects budget 'Local' 29,309 (p18) cannot contain 417,952. Added as printed in their fund columns. Tie: 24,358 + 417,952 = 442,310 vs JSON other_financing 442,308 (p7 Total column 417,950 + 24,358): difference 2 = the report's own rounding in the Insurance proceeds Total.

Sum 11,396,141 (added). JSON business-type receipts 11,392,967 = the Business-type Totals column (11,850,396 + 164,087 + (621,516)), which also includes the Business-type Activities 'Internal Service' column (p11: Investment income (3,175)). Residual 11,392,967 - 11,396,141 = -3,174 = Internal Service (3,175) + 1 (the columns add to (621,517); Totals prints (621,516)).
